title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: If we have a season credential, we still have to apply daily, right?
Correct, just to help with our daily numbers
Thank you for this, this is helpful
That was really good.... Here are my follow-ups
Is it 35 people total per game? So like, if we were to go to a Cleveland game, and they have 40 people on the list, would they bump local people out for us because we’re a season credential holder?

Anthony, yes the cap per game is 35 media. That includes both home/road media. If a team goes over the cap of 35, I think it would be up to the home team’s discretion as to who would have access to the ballpark. I would hope there would at least be a limited number of spots reserved for visiting media. The season credential is only good for workouts/games at Comerica Park.
